[[File:Rachel.png|thumb|220px|Rachel]] '''Rachel''' (Japanese: '''レイ''' ''Rei'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. She is [[Jin]]'s wife and assists the [[Mossdeep Space Center]] as a mission control operator. Rachel is also the mother of the [[Mossdeep City]] [[Gym Leader]]s [[Tate and Liza]]. She made her debut appearance in ''[[AG099|It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!]]'', where she was rushing out of the [[Mossdeep Gym]] to make it to the local Space Center. The group decided to follow her there and later encounter the twin Mossdeep Gym Leaders. Meanwhile, Rachel kept watch over the impending shuttle launch as her husband prepared for his next space voyage. {{TRT}} hijacked the rocket launch, though her son Tate was able to deal with the trio and land the craft safely. During ''[[AG100|Solid as a Solrock]]'', Rachel acted as the [[Battle judge|referee]] during {{Ash}}'s Mossdeep Gym challenge. Team Rocket gatecrashed the battle and stole Tate and Liza's Pokémon, partially destroying the Gym in the process.
